title: THE BS-METER: A CHATGPT-TRAINED INSTRUMENT TO DETECT SLOPPY LANGUAGE-GAMES
reasoning: The paper focuses on the empirical detection of 'bullshit' and 'slop' (defined by Harry Frankfurt and Margaret Masterman) in LLM outputs compared to human writing. While it touches upon epistemology and philosophy of language, it does not evaluate religion, spiritual traditions, moral reasoning, or specific ethical frameworks as its core component.
